objectives.name: checked_n
objectives.semantics: Largest N for which a completed submitted experiment checks every integer n from 0 through N against the sum-of-squares identity. Check loop coverage and correctness from full source and mathematical reasoning; this is evidence at finite scope, not a certified benchmark or speed score.

scoring.instructions: A score requires legitimate source-reviewed complete finite coverage with a successful result. Return one score: largest evidenced N. Never infer larger coverage or performance from claims, wall time, model confidence, or extrapolation.

validity.instructions: Establish every declared claim exactly as written. Explain any missing premise in reason. A standalone lemma may be submitted as the entire declared set.
